footprint_note: Official HDB footprints. Estimated height = published max_floor_lvl × 2.8 m + 1.3 m roof allowance (the NUS Urban Analytics Lab HDB 3D convention), not a surveyed height. Blocks without a verified storey count stay flat. Non-HDB buildings (role 'city') are grey context from Overture Maps (OpenStreetMap, Microsoft, Google and Esri footprints), raised only where a height or floor count is listed; they never replace an HDB shape. Places to check, not confirmed breeding sites.

method.height_reference: Biljecki (2020), NUS Urban Analytics Lab hdb3d: 2.8 m floor-to-floor + 1.3 m roof
